purpose: Check PSD, unchanged marginals, shared nullspace and numerical rank stability in proposed interior sensitivity grid; no means/likelihood or model choice
alternatives_before_measurement: Reconstruct physical common-error components and host-anchor Jacobian (A), requiring unavailable primitive budgets/catalog coupling.
Qualify full proposed restricted PSD family (B), reporting algebraic/implementation properties only; no correlation estimate.
selected_for_control: B; no scientific adoption of covariance grid
allowed_inputs: Listed JSON errors/identifiers, local reviewed guard and own script only; no upstream imports or catalogue centres.
case_policy: All100 interior fraction tuples in each3 sign scenarios; same primitive matrix hashes collapsed deterministically; no best scenario selection.
failure_policy: Visible failure; no silent clipping or retry.
limitations: Stellar block only; not full SN/network/background covariance.
Algebraic family not measurement of residual covariance.
MAS-HMS cross-level terms excluded; no automatic aggregate-budget additions.
No S/g/H0/lnB, observed residual or significance.
No change to V1 or opening decision.
